question: Under which Amendment to the Constitution Act was the reservation for OBCs in educational institutions made?
solution:
The correct answer is __**93rd Amendment.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• 93rd Amendment -This amendment was done in 2006.

 
 
• In this, the reservation of seats has been arranged for admission of citizens of scheduled castes and tribes and other backward classes in educational institutions.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** 94th Amendment**

 
 
• The Constitution (Ninety-fourth Amendment) Act, 2006, made arrangements for the arrangement of a Clergyman responsible for ancestral government assistance in the territories of Chhattisgarh and Jharkhand. A Demonstration further to correct the Constitution of India.
 
 
 
• **95th Amendment**
 
 
• Broadened the booking of seats for the SCs and STs and extraordinary portrayal for the Somewhat English Indians in the Lok Sabha and the state regulative congregations for a further time of a decade i.e, up to 2020 (Article 334).
 
 
 
• **96th Amendment**
 
 
• The Ninety-6th Amendment Demonstration of 2011 subbed "Odia" for "Odiya". Subsequently, the "Oriya" language in the Eighth Timetable will be articulated as "Odia".
